name: 八爪鱼|亚马逊商品数据抓取
description_zh: 通过八爪鱼 MCP 按关键词或 ASIN 采集 Amazon 商品列表、商品详情和用户评论，支持多个 Amazon 站点，并导出 UTF-8-BOM CSV 文件。支持完整采集、列表采集、详情采集、评论采集和已有结果导出。免费版与个人版通过 MCP 调用每周最多 2000 条；团队版不限条数。
description_en: Collect Amazon product listings, product details, and customer reviews through the Bazhuayu MCP by keyword or ASIN. Supports multiple Amazon marketplaces, complete keyword-to-CSV workflows, listing-only collection, ASIN detail collection, ASIN review collection, resumable staged runs, contract-validated JSON results, and UTF-8-BOM CSV export. The Free and Personal plans support up to 2,000 MCP records per week; Team plans have no record limit. API keys must be configured securely in WorkBuddy and are never written to logs, run state, CSV files, or chat.
